entities.name: ATP synthase gamma chain
observations: The 289-aa query sequence exactly matches reviewed UniProt entry A5EXJ6 from Dichelobacter nodosus.
The gamma subunit is part of the F-type proton-transporting ATP synthase and helps regulate rotational ATPase activity and proton flow.
Pfam ATP-synt domain PF00231 spans residues 3–289.
Annotated as a peripheral component associated with the bacterial inner membrane through the ATP synthase complex.
Annotated in proton motive force-driven ATP synthesis, ATP synthase complex, ATP binding, and rotational ATP synthase activity.
F-type ATP synthase F1 sector contains alpha3 beta3 gamma delta epsilon; the gamma chain is present as one copy.
Sequence-derived properties: length 289 aa, estimated molecular mass 32.2 kDa, theoretical pI 9.35, and positive charge at pH 7.

entities.name: Proton motive force ATP synthesis
observations: The protein participates in the F-type ATP synthase process that couples proton motive force to ATP production.

entities.name: Bacterial inner membrane
observations: The gamma chain is annotated as a peripheral membrane protein associated with the bacterial plasma/inner membrane via the ATP synthase complex; it is not itself predicted to be a transmembrane protein.
